versions.changelog: Removed the evidence log: the portrait keeps current conclusions only. Size cap tightened to 60 lines.
Scope tightened: coarse-granularity expertise only (no projects/resumes), workflow rules excluded, passive concept-level comprehension tracking added, evidence log restricted to abstract signals.

Initial release: persistent user portrait — learn the user's language, expertise, gaps, and communication preferences into one local file and phrase every reply so they understand it. Hook-free variant of the user-portrait Claude Code plugin; shares the same portrait file.
